items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: We went on tour opening up for them, like we did this southern tour and then I became friends with LeRoi

ctx.x: Great, yeah. It was amazing. And I was good friends. Well you know our relationship with them started with Soulive. We went on tour opening up for them, like we did this southern tour and then I became friends with LeRoi, the saxophone player who passed away, and so we kind of just had a relationship with them. Whenever they would come through I would sit in and also now that Jeff Coffin is in the band, who I’ve been friends with, so if they’re ever around like in Albany or like that, we go check them out.
